test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Padma Bhushan awardee Mogubai Kurdikar was associated with which of the following music styles?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hindustani Classical music**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Padma Bhushan awardee Mogubai Kurdikar was a renowned exponent of **Hindustani Classical music**.
 
• She was associated with the **Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana**, one of the prominent schools of Hindustani music.
 
• Mogubai Kurdikar was a disciple of **Ustad Alladiya Khan**, the founder of the Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana.
 
• She is credited with popularizing and preserving the intricate musical compositions and techniques of this gharana.
 
• Mogubai was also the mother of Kishori Amonkar, a legendary Hindustani classical vocalist who carried forward her legacy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hindustani Classical Music:**

 
 
• It is one of the two main traditions of Indian classical music, the other being Carnatic music.
 
• Hindustani music is characterized by its emphasis on improvisation and exploration of ragas.
 
• This tradition evolved during the Mughal era, incorporating Persian and Islamic influences.
 
• Prominent instruments include the sitar, tabla, and harmonium.
 
 
 
• **Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana:**
 
 
• Known for its complex and intricate compositions, especially in rare ragas.
 
• Established by Ustad Alladiya Khan in the late 19th century.
 
• Focuses on slow elaboration of ragas and a systematic approach to swaras (notes).
 
 
 
• **Padma Bhushan Award:**
 
 
• It is India's third-highest civilian award, instituted in 1954.
 
• Awarded for distinguished service of a high order in any field.
 
• Mogubai Kurdikar received the Padma Bhushan for her contribution to Indian classical music.
 
 
 
• **Kishori Amonkar:**
 
 
• Daughter of Mogubai Kurdikar and a celebrated Hindustani classical vocalist.
 
• She expanded the Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana's repertoire by blending classical traditions with innovative approaches.
 
• Known for her emotive and nuanced performances.
